law_name: Law No. 81 of 2018 on Electronic Transactions and Personal Data
scope: Individuals whose personal data is processed (unconfirmed)
key_requirements: Consent or other legal basis, purpose limitation, security; licence or authorization from the Ministry of Economy and Trade for processing certain data categories (unconfirmed)
data_categories: Personal data; sensitive data requiring licence (unconfirmed)
enforcement_authority: Ministry of Economy and Trade (no dedicated authority; some sources name Ministry of Telecommunications / TRA)
genetic_data: Processing of data revealing health, genetic identity or sexual life allowed only in listed cases (art. 91); needs Minister of Public Health authorization (art. 97)
notes: Mixed e-commerce/e-signature law with a personal data chapter; no independent DPA; sources conflict on regulator.
